scenes.title: The Egg on the Farm
scenes.card: A child finds a giant egg on the farm; it hatches into a baby raptor who panics the animals, until an apple, a lot of thunder and a very large mother bring everyone home.

scenes.title: A strange egg
scenes.card: Moss finds a giant egg in the field. Farmer Hazel has never seen one like it.

subtitles.text: Farmer Hazel: Good morning, everyone. Another quiet morning on the farm.
Moss: Farmer Hazel, come quick! There is something in the field!
Farmer Hazel: That is no hen’s egg. Whatever laid it must be enormous.

hud.text: A strange egg in the field

scenes.title: It hatched!
scenes.card: The egg hatches into a baby raptor. The farm animals panic.

subtitles.text: Moss: Hazel, the egg is moving!
Farmer Hazel: It hatched! What on earth is it?
Moss: He is a baby dinosaur! A real one!

scenes.title: Chaos on the farm
scenes.card: The baby raptor runs through the farm and every animal scatters. Hazel falls.

subtitles.text: Farmer Hazel: Stop! Stop! He is scaring the whole farm!

scenes.title: Just hungry
scenes.card: Moss calms the baby raptor with an apple. He is just hungry, and lost.

subtitles.text: Moss: Look at him. He is not angry. He is scared and hungry.
Farmer Hazel: Well, I never. He is only a baby. Where did he come from?
Moss: He must have lost his mother. He is looking for her.

scenes.title: The ground shakes
scenes.card: The ground shakes. Something enormous walks toward the farm.

subtitles.text: Farmer Hazel: The whole ground is shaking! Something much bigger is coming. Run!
Moss: Wait. Maybe it is his mother.

scenes.title: Mama
scenes.card: Zip runs to his mother. The farmer and the child watch them reunite.

subtitles.text: Moss: Don’t be scared, Hazel. Look at Zip. He knows her.
Farmer Hazel: She searched all night for him. Mothers always find their children.

scenes.title: Over the hill
scenes.card: The dinosaurs go home. The farm animals come back and the farm is quiet again.

subtitles.text: Moss: Goodbye, Zip! Come back and visit us!
Farmer Hazel: Best egg we ever had.
Moss: Can we have another one?
